Option 2 says "Other procedure done that confirmed presence of DVT". This phrasing is slightly ambiguous: did the procedure itself confirm it, or was a procedure done and DVT was confirmed (perhaps by imaging)? Given the explicit statement "venografia... ha confermato", and venography is an imaging modality, one might argue for Option 3 if strictly interpreting "procedure confirms". However, pharmacomechanical thrombolysis is an invasive procedure. The text says the patient *was subjected to* this procedure. It is not "No surgical procedure done". So Option 3 is out.
